# machine-translated first pass, corrections welcome
# F4Multiplayer texts: Español (Latinoamérica) (Latin American Spanish, for the game's esmx). It follows es.txt: no vosotros forms, "tú" for the player and "ustedes" for several, Latin American vocabulary where it differs from Spain's. The format and the keys are explained in en.txt; keep the {placeholders} as they are.

session.connected_shared = Multijugador: conectado (historia compartida)
session.connected_own = Multijugador: conectado (cada quien tiene su propia historia)
session.connected_shared_fire = Multijugador: conectado (historia compartida, fuego amigo activado)
session.connected_own_fire = Multijugador: conectado (cada quien tiene su propia historia, fuego amigo activado)
